Magyarhomorog Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Árpád utca 3, Hungary

Demolished. This record's description field contains only placeholder text ('Let's say we have some text here') rather than genuine historical content — flagged here rather than treated as real information, consistent with a pattern seen elsewhere in this collection. What can be reported from the genuine portion of the site-condition notes: the former cemetery site sits next to the local Christian cemetery, and two of its gravestones were repurposed years ago to mark a Christian grave there, for reasons the source could not explain.
